knowledge:
- key_parameters: dataDir=Directory containing Tablemaker output folders for each sample ;; samplePattern=Regular expression specifying which subfolders in dataDir to include ;; samples=Vector of full paths to sample directories (alternative to dataDir and samplePattern) ;; meas=Expression measurement to load (e.g., 'all', 'FPKM', 'cov', 'rcount') ;; feature=Genomic feature to test in stattest ('transcript', 'exon', 'intron', 'gene', or 'transcript_cluster') ;; covariate=The variable of interest in pData to test for differential expression ;; timecourse=Logical; if TRUE, fits a smooth curve to the covariate using natural splines ;; adjustvars=Character vector of confounding variables in pData to adjust for in the model ;; mod=Full model design matrix for custom nested model comparisons ;; mod0=Reduced model design matrix nested within mod
- alternatives: limma, limma Voom, DESeq, DEXSeq, or edgeR can be preferred for differential expression analysis by extracting feature-by-sample expression tables using *expr functions (e.g., texpr, eexpr, iexpr, gexpr) if users prefer their specific statistical frameworks (e.g., empirical Bayes shrinkage or count-based models).
- when_to_use: Appropriate when you have transcript-level, exon-level, or intron-level expression estimates generated by Tablemaker (which runs Cufflinks) and want to perform flexible differential expression testing, adjust for covariates, model timecourse data, or visualize transcript structures.
- pitfalls: Loading data for large experiments can be slow and memory-intensive; use non-interactive mode (R CMD BATCH) and save the object as an .rda file ;; The rows of pData must be in the exact same order as the tables in the expr slot (verify with sampleNames(bg)) ;; If you have very few timepoints (fewer than 5) in a timecourse experiment, do not set timecourse=TRUE (which uses splines); instead, treat time as a categorical variable (timecourse=FALSE) to avoid warnings or coercion ;; Calculating gene-level expression measurements (gexpr) can be slow for large experiments.

workflows.name: differential_expression_analysis
workflows.intent: Load Tablemaker output, define phenotype data, visualize transcripts, and perform differential expression testing (including timecourse and covariate adjustment).
workflows.stages: 1. Load Tablemaker output into a ballgown object using ballgown() ;; 2. Assign phenotype data to the object using pData() ;; 3. Extract expression matrices using texpr() or gexpr() ;; 4. Visualize transcript structures and mean abundances using plotTranscripts() and plotMeans() ;; 5. Perform differential expression testing using stattest() with optional timecourse or covariate adjustment.
workflows.code:
library(ballgown)
data_directory = system.file('extdata', package='ballgown')
bg = ballgown(dataDir=data_directory, samplePattern='sample', meas='all')
pData(bg) = data.frame(id=sampleNames(bg), group=rep(c(1,0), each=10))
transcript_fpkm = texpr(bg, 'FPKM')
plotTranscripts(gene='XLOC_000454', gown=bg, samples='sample12', meas='FPKM', colorby='transcript', main='transcripts from gene XLOC_000454: sample 12, FPKM')
plotMeans('XLOC_000454', bg, groupvar='group', meas='FPKM', colorby='transcript')
stat_results = stattest(bg, feature='transcript', meas='FPKM', covariate='group')
pData(bg) = data.frame(pData(bg), time=rep(1:10, 2))
timecourse_results = stattest(bg, feature='transcript', meas='FPKM', covariate='time', timecourse=TRUE)
group_adj_timecourse_results = stattest(bg, feature='transcript', meas='FPKM', covariate='time', timecourse=TRUE, adjustvars='group')

workflows.name: custom_model_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression testing using custom nested design matrices to adjust for multiple complex covariates.
workflows.stages: 1. Load Tablemaker output and define phenotype data ;; 2. Create custom design matrices using model.matrix() ;; 3. Run differential expression testing comparing nested models using stattest().
workflows.code:
library(ballgown)
data_directory = system.file('extdata', package='ballgown')
bg = ballgown(dataDir=data_directory, samplePattern='sample', meas='all')
pData(bg) = data.frame(id=sampleNames(bg), group=rep(c(1,0), each=10))
pData(bg) = data.frame(pData(bg), time=rep(1:10, 2))
set.seed(43)
sex = sample(c('M','F'), size=nrow(pData(bg)), replace=TRUE)
age = sample(21:52, size=nrow(pData(bg)), replace=TRUE)
mod = model.matrix(~ sex + age + pData(bg)$group + pData(bg)$time)
mod0 = model.matrix(~ pData(bg)$group + pData(bg)$time)
adjusted_results = stattest(bg, feature='transcript', meas='FPKM', mod0=mod0, mod=mod)

workflows.name: transcript_clustering_and_testing
workflows.intent: Cluster similar transcripts within a gene to handle expression estimation uncertainty, and perform differential expression testing on the collapsed transcript clusters.
workflows.stages: 1. Cluster transcripts using clusterTranscripts() ;; 2. Visualize clusters using plotLatentTranscripts() ;; 3. Collapse transcript expression using collapseTranscripts() ;; 4. Perform differential expression testing on collapsed clusters using stattest().
workflows.code:
library(ballgown)
data_directory = system.file('extdata', package='ballgown')
bg = ballgown(dataDir=data_directory, samplePattern='sample', meas='all')
pData(bg) = data.frame(id=sampleNames(bg), group=rep(c(1,0), each=10))
clusterTranscripts(gene='XLOC_000454', gown=bg, k=2, method='kmeans')
plotLatentTranscripts(gene='XLOC_000454', gown=bg, k=2, method='kmeans', returncluster=FALSE)
agg = collapseTranscripts(gene='XLOC_000454', gown=bg, k=2, method='kmeans')
stattest(gowntable=agg$tab, pData=pData(bg), feature='transcript_cluster', covariate='group', libadjust=FALSE)
